in the measured table is never guessed: it is the speed this account really made on that hunt with this Pokémon (after 300 kills, saved between restarts, kept apart for each account, each Pokémon and each party size; ≈ means it was measured at a quite different level). per kill

≈
columns of Worth testing add an
estimate
of kills/h (and the gold and XP per hour that follow from it) worked out from your own measured speeds, with the error it made on speeds it had not seen; it is only made for a party of 1 and for hunts whose model kill time lies inside what has been measured.
Gold per kill
= loot sold to the NPC + what the ball earns − potions, counted per kill of this account.
XP per kill
= the game’s formula × the bonus measured on your current hunt per shared kill (VIP, boosts, party).
Kill time vs now
compares how long your active Pokémon needs to kill a wild one (stats, level, type chart, moves) with your current hunt. It only counts the lead Pokémon, so a party kills faster than shown. In a party, the game’s kill counter is shared; the share of this account is shown. Drops worth $10K or more are not averaged in; they are shown as rare drops.
